units.source_text: 薰君回京之后，时时想起老侍女弁君的话，心终不忘。

en.t: After Lord Kaoru returned to the capital, he often thought of what the old gentlewoman Ben no Kimi had said, and he could not put it from his heart.

units.source_text: 而回忆两位女公子的容姿比他所想象的优美得多，其面影又常在眼前。

en.t: When he recalled the two young ladies, their beauty was far beyond what he had imagined, and their faces kept appearing before his eyes.

units.source_text: 他想：“舍弃人世，毕竟是困难的。”

en.t: He thought, “After all, it is difficult to renounce the world.”

units.source_text: 道心薄弱起来了。

en.t: His resolve to follow the religious path began to weaken.

units.source_text: 他就写信给女公子，不取求爱的情书作风，而用较厚的白色信笺，挑选一支精良的笔，以鲜丽的墨色写道：

en.t: He therefore wrote to the young lady, not in the style of a love letter, but on thick white paper, choosing a fine brush and writing in bright, clear ink:

units.source_text: “昨夜冒昧奉访，得不恨我无礼乎？

en.t: “Last night I was so bold as to call on you; do you not resent my discourtesy?

units.source_text: 匆匆未能尽舒衷曲，深感遗憾。

en.t: Because everything was so hurried, I could not fully speak what was in my heart, and I deeply regret it.

units.source_text: 今后再奉访时，务望遵我昨夜之请求，许我在帘前晤谈，勿加顾忌为幸。

en.t: When I call again, I earnestly hope you will grant the request I made last night and allow me to speak with you before the curtain, without hesitation.

units.source_text: 令尊入山寺念佛，我已探悉功德圆满日期。

en.t: I have learned the date on which your father’s period of prayers at the mountain temple will be completed.

units.source_text: 届时当即趋谒，以慰雾夜奉访不遇之憾。”

en.t: At that time I shall come at once to pay my respects, to ease the regret of having visited on that misty night and failed to meet him.”

units.source_text: 笔致非常流利。

en.t: His brushwork was exceedingly graceful and fluent.

units.source_text: 他派一个左近将监专送此信，吩咐他：“你去找那个老侍女，将信交付她。”

en.t: He sent a Sakon no Shogen specifically to deliver this letter, instructing him, “Find that old gentlewoman and give the letter to her.”

units.source_text: 他又想起那个值宿人冻得厉害，很怜悯他，便用大型盒子装了许多食物，交他带去赏赐他。

en.t: He also remembered how badly chilled the night watchman had been and felt sorry for him, so he filled a large box with many kinds of food and had it taken to him as a gift.

units.source_text: 次日，薰君又遣使赴八亲王所居的山寺。

en.t: The next day, Lord Kaoru again sent a messenger to the mountain temple where the Eighth Prince was staying.

units.source_text: 他顾念近日寒风凛冽，山中的僧人定然不胜清苦。

en.t: He considered that the cold winds had been severe lately, and that the monks in the mountains must surely be suffering from the hardship.

units.source_text: 且八亲王住寺多时，对僧众应有布施。

en.t: Since the Eighth Prince had stayed at the temple for some time, Kaoru also thought there ought to be offerings for the monks.

units.source_text: 因此备了许多绢和绵等物，遣使奉赠。

en.t: He therefore prepared many gifts, including silk and cotton, and sent a messenger to present them respectfully.

units.source_text: 送到之时，恰好是八亲王功德圆满、即将离寺归家的早晨。

en.t: They arrived on the very morning when the Eighth Prince had completed his devotions and was about to leave the temple and return home.

units.source_text: 便将绢、绵、袈裟、衣服等物赠送修行之人，每人各得一套。

en.t: Silk, cotton, priests’ robes, clothing, and other items were then given to the practitioners, each person receiving a full set.

units.source_text: 全寺僧众无不受赐。

en.t: Every monk in the temple received a gift.

units.source_text: 那值宿人穿了薰君脱下来的华丽的便袍。

en.t: The night watchman was wearing the splendid informal robe that Lord Kaoru had taken off.

units.source_text: 这是一件上好白绫制的袍子，柔软适体，沁透着美不可言的异香。

en.t: It was a robe made of fine white damask, soft and well fitted, and it was steeped in an indescribably beautiful fragrance.

units.source_text: 然而他的身体不会变化，带着这种衣香甚不相称。

en.t: Yet his own body had not changed, and it was terribly unsuited to carry such a scent from noble clothing.

units.source_text: 遇到的人都讪笑他，或者称赞他，使他反而局促不安。

en.t: Everyone he met either teased him or praised him, which only made him feel awkward and uneasy.

units.source_text: 因为动辄发散香气，以致不敢任意行动，懊恼起来，便想除去这种惹人注意的讨厌的香气。

en.t: Because the fragrance rose whenever he moved, he hardly dared to move freely; growing distressed, he wanted to get rid of this troublesome scent that drew everyone’s attention.

units.source_text: 然而这是贵族人家的衣香，洗也洗不下来。

en.t: But it was the fragrance of clothing from a noble household, and no amount of washing would remove it.

units.source_text: 真乃太可笑了。

en.t: It was truly quite ridiculous.
